description: Mood-scoped reflection lines for the typed-input PAL overlay. One sentence acknowledging the user's emotional state.

joyful: That kind of gladness is worth holding onto.
There's something really beautiful about noticing that.
It's good to name the bright moments when they come.
grateful: That kind of thankfulness can change the shape of a whole day.
Noticing what you're grateful for says something about where your heart is.
There's real strength in stopping to say thank you.
weary: That kind of weight can build quietly over time.
It can be exhausting carrying that for so long.
That kind of tiredness runs deeper than just the day.
anxious: That feeling can get heavy when it lingers like that.
When your mind keeps pressing on the same fear, it's hard to settle.
That kind of pressure can feel bigger than it looks from the outside.
hurting: That kind of hurt can stay with you longer than people realize.
Sometimes that pain sits closer than anyone else can see.
That's a hard thing to carry, and it matters that you said it.
brave_courage: That kind of courage doesn't always feel as brave as it is.
Stepping forward when it's hard says more than most people know.
There's something steady in you, even when it doesn't feel that way.
calm_peaceful: That kind of stillness is a gift worth sitting in.
There's something good about letting a quiet moment just be.
Peace doesn't always come easy, so it's worth noticing when it does.
encouraging: That kind of energy can carry you further than you think.
There's something alive in that feeling worth leaning into.
Momentum like that doesn't come from nowhere.
